scope: Claire and Marc Bourgie Pavilion at 1339 Sherbrooke Street West. The standing exterior includes 1894 church body and attached five-gallery building.
geometryBasis: Native pavilion way 104104907 and the official campus membership, preserved in the local Sherbrooke frame.
sectionBasis: The verified original records the rounded Romanesque portals, rough pale-gray stone with warm surrounds, large fan-like semicircular window and tiers of arcade openings. From Sherbrooke the tall square bell tower is on the left, the smaller pyramidal slate roof on the right. The same native polygon encloses the rear marble-clad contemporary gallery described by its architects.
